answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Each name is charged 3 letters of reference, each one priced at $33, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. A seat is earned, not claimed: Dockbound narrowboatman beacon charter makes sure of that, since a charter narrowboatmen file after dock checks. The hollow is on the docket. Every onyx is counted once. The tally keeps spiral.
